svg.title: AkiDB write workflow
svg.desc: Direct vector writes and the optional document pipeline both map external IDs, persist to RocksDB, update in-memory indexes, and reload from a matching HNSW snapshot on startup.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the persisted records. A later vector insert or delete changes the

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: snapshot fingerprint, so the next open rebuilds the graph.
